raw_text:
Here’s your field briefing:

•	**FLAG:** This is a PITCH_WITH_FLAG, so be prepared to discuss the potential for increased costs and complexity due to the existing rotklinker façade. Document the exact location and extent of the rotklinker thoroughly.
•	**CLARIFY:** Confirm with the homeowner that they absolutely do not want the rotklinker covered – this is a critical constraint impacting the proposed Einblasdämmung method.
•	**CONFIRM ON-SITE:** Verify the cavity depth is truly 5cm. Measure it directly; discrepancies will impact the required insulation thickness and therefore cost.
•	**PRICE CAREFULLY:** The access method – drilling through existing fuge (joints) – will likely increase material and labour costs. Get a detailed breakdown of this aspect from the estimator.
•	**NOTE:** Previous similar leads in DDR_Ost have had a 0% close rate. Be prepared for a potentially lengthy sales process and focus on clearly demonstrating the benefits of Kerndämmung alongside the Einblasdämmung.
